# Soundcore

> Soundcore is an audio-first brand offering premium wireless earbuds, headphones, speakers, projectors, and voice recording devices with advanced noise cancellation and spatial audio technologies.

Soundcore specializes in innovative audio products ranging from open-ear earbuds and sleep-focused audio devices to 4K laser projectors with Dolby Atmos. The brand combines cutting-edge technologies like Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), LDAC codec support, and AI-powered features across consumer electronics and professional tools.

## Key Topics

- Active Noise Cancellation (ANC)
- Open-ear earbuds
- Wireless audio
- Dolby Atmos
- 4K laser projectors
- Sleep earbuds
- LDAC codec
- AeroFit 2 Pro
- Nebula projectors
- Bluetooth connectivity
- Noise reduction
- Hi-Res audio
- Voice transcription
- Portable speakers
- Smart audio devices
